heading: Introduction
text:
XATA

Business Requirements Document (BRD)

RFP: XATA Enterprise TODO Management Platform
Client: XATA | Delivery Partner: XBS | Version 1.0

heading: 1. Document Purpose
text: XATA is issuing this Business Requirements Document to XBS for the design and implementation of a simple enterprise TODO Management Platform. The platform will allow XATA employees to create, manage, prioritize, track and complete personal and team TODO items.

heading: 2. Business Background
text: XATA currently manages TODO items through a combination of email, spreadsheets, chat messages and personal notes. This makes it difficult to maintain a single view of outstanding work, identify overdue items and understand team workload. XATA wants a simple centralized web application that provides a common place to manage TODOs while keeping the first release intentionally small and easy to use.

heading: 3. Business Objectives
text:
Provide a single system for managing TODO items.

Allow users to quickly create and update TODOs.

Provide visibility of open, completed and overdue work.

Allow team members to assign TODOs to one another.

Provide basic priority and due-date management.

Provide a simple dashboard for work tracking.

Reduce dependency on spreadsheets, email and chat for TODO tracking.

heading: 4.1 In Scope
text:
User login and basic user profile.

Create, view, edit and delete TODOs.

Mark TODOs as completed.

Assign TODOs to users.

Set priority and due date.

Add description and optional notes.

Filter and search TODOs.

Dashboard showing TODO status.

Basic team view for assigned TODOs.

Audit information such as created date and updated date.

heading: 4.2 Out of Scope
text:
Advanced project management.

Gantt charts.

Time tracking.

Resource capacity planning.

Chat or collaboration features.

File/document management.

AI-generated TODOs.

Mobile native applications.

Complex workflow approvals.

External customer access.

heading: 5. Users and Roles
text:
Role | Description | Key Responsibilities
Employee | Normal platform user | Create/manage own TODOs; view assigned TODOs; update status.
Team Lead | Team-level user | Create/assign TODOs; view team TODOs; monitor overdue work.
Administrator | Platform administrator | Manage users and basic platform configuration.

heading: 6. Business Requirements
text:
ID | Requirement | Priority
BR-001 | System shall allow an authenticated user to create a TODO. | Must
BR-002 | A TODO shall contain title, description, status, priority and due date. | Must
BR-003 | Users shall be able to edit TODOs they own or are authorized to manage. | Must
BR-004 | Users shall be able to mark TODOs as completed. | Must
BR-005 | Users shall be able to assign a TODO to another authorized user. | Must
BR-006 | System shall support Open, In Progress and Completed statuses. | Must
BR-007 | System shall support Low, Medium, High and Critical priorities. | Must
BR-008 | Users shall filter TODOs by status, priority, assignee and due date. | Must

heading: 6. Business Requirements
text:
ID | Requirement | Priority
BR-009 | Users shall search TODOs by title or description. | Should
BR-010 | Dashboard shall show Open, In Progress, Completed and Overdue counts. | Must
BR-011 | Team Leads shall view TODOs assigned to their team members. | Must
BR-012 | System shall maintain created-by, created-date, updated-by and updated-date. | Must
BR-013 | Users shall be able to delete TODOs where permitted. | Should
BR-014 | System shall prevent unauthorized modification of another user's TODO. | Must
BR-015 | System shall provide a web interface through supported browsers. | Must

heading: 7.1 Create TODO
text:
Enter title.

Enter description.

Select priority.

Select due date.

Optionally assign to a user.

Save the TODO.

heading: 7.2 Manage TODO
text:
View details.

Edit information.

Change status.

Change priority or due date.

Reassign where authorized.

Delete where authorized.

heading: 7.3 Dashboard
text:
Total open TODOs.

In-progress TODOs.

Completed TODOs.

Overdue TODOs.

High/Critical priority TODOs.

heading: 8. Business Rules
text:
A TODO must have a title.

A due date cannot be earlier than creation date unless explicitly permitted.

Completed TODOs must have Completed status.

Only authorized users can assign or modify TODOs.

Overdue means due date has passed and status is not Completed.

Deleting a TODO must not delete the user account or other TODOs.

heading: 9. Assumptions
text:
XATA will provide the user list and team structure.

XATA will provide branding requirements.

Initial release is web-based.

XBS will propose the technical architecture based on the BRD and NFR.

First release will use a single enterprise environment.

heading: 10. Acceptance Criteria
text:
User can log in and create a TODO.

TODO can be assigned, updated and completed.

Dashboard counts correctly reflect TODO state.

Users cannot modify TODOs outside their authorization.

Filtering and search return correct results.

Application meets agreed NFRs.

XATA can complete the core TODO lifecycle without administrator assistance.

heading: 11. Stakeholders
text:
Organization | Role
XATA | Business Owner / Client
XBS | Implementation Partner
XATA Business Users | End Users
XATA IT | Technical / Operational Stakeholders

heading: 12. Approval
text: This BRD represents the business requirements provided by XATA to XBS for solution design and implementation. Detailed technical design and implementation decisions are to be proposed by XBS and agreed with XATA.
